request.initial_prompt: [_A page or more has here been torn out of the Ms. from which all our copies of "The Bacchae" are derived. It evidently contained a speech of Agave (followed presumably by some words of the Chorus), and an appearance of_ Dionysus _upon a cloud. He must have pronounced judgment upon the Thebans in general, and especially upon the daughters of_ Cadmus, _have justified his own action, and declared his determination to establish his godhead. Where the Ms. begins again, we find him addressing_ Cadmus.] * * * * *
